58bc83a0-1808-484e-88b9-17e167469e23.title: Lv2 kara Cheat datta Moto Yuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life
58bc83a0-1808-484e-88b9-17e167469e23.altTitle: Chillin Different World Life of the EX-Brave Candidate was Cheat from Lv 2
58bc83a0-1808-484e-88b9-17e167469e23.description: Banaza, who was summoned to the magic kingdom of Klyrode as a Hero candidate, was disqualified as a Hero because of his ordinary abilities. He was supposed to be returned to his original world, but due to the magical kingdom's mistake, he became unable to return to his original world. However, the moment he reached Level 2, he acquired every single possible skill and kind of magic, turning him into a super cheat with infinite skills! Despite this, he takes Fenrys of the demons as his wife, and fully enjoys his newly-married life with an easygoing smile. He changes his name to Flio and tries to lead his life quietly, but things are a bit chaotic with the likes of a pet saber, four freeloading female knights, a Majin, and even an ex-Demon Lord. However, even with all of this chaos, he still manages to enjoy his life peacefully.

chapters.title: The Three Djinns of the Dark World

384308ae-cf17-490c-9a9e-8bb0db90c3e6.title: The Villain's Survival Route
384308ae-cf17-490c-9a9e-8bb0db90c3e6.description: Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woojin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woojin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

c4b36f15-4ee5-425f-a77d-c2e7cbb970d8.description:
In the near future, after the collapse of civilization, a young man stands up to reunite Japan, which has once again entered a Warring States Era.

His name is Misumi Aoteru. Later described as a military genius, his legend begins now!!

6033535e-ea6a-4f52-9d81-17101a739c33.title: Noumin Kanren no Skill bakka Agetetara Nazeka Tsuyoku Natta.
6033535e-ea6a-4f52-9d81-17101a739c33.altTitle: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
6033535e-ea6a-4f52-9d81-17101a739c33.description:
To live from bottom-class to top-class farmer, our protagonist Aru Wayn levelled up his agricultural skills, and sometimes his other skills leveled up as well by helping out his friends. One day, when his last skill level hit MAX, his life changes.

"I want to live as a normal farmer!!"

8681915b-2330-4fed-ba56-949f1bb26050.altTitle: The Dying Girl and the Spider Prince
8681915b-2330-4fed-ba56-949f1bb26050.description:
[This is the serialized version.]

Nanakawa Nehan's boyfriend is a kumo-otoko monster. Her days are full of anguish: even if she wants to share steamy moments with her monstruous boyfriend Yatsuzuka-kun, due to him being a late bloomer and "special circumstances", he just won't fall easily for her advances.

"Even if it means destroying the walls between species, I'll give my best today too so I can have lots of steamy moments with Yatsuzuka-kun!!"

The curtains open to an explosive, steamy and full of love comedy!

fc0dbb8a-8e13-4c8b-aebc-14b16168cdb4.description: Fukayama Aki, a beastman who has lived quietly, blending in among humans. One day suddenly finds a beastman child, Tsukiko, coming into his life! From this unexpected turn of events begins a shared life between two complete opposites: an awkward adult and a straightforward child. The two live. In a world not made for their sake, in order to keep on living.

375be9e1-5d08-44bd-a99b-b71b8b29bc40.title: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
375be9e1-5d08-44bd-a99b-b71b8b29bc40.altTitle: How Could You Repay the Kindness I Raised You With Obsession?
375be9e1-5d08-44bd-a99b-b71b8b29bc40.description:
I transmigrated into the body of an evil witch in a fairytale.
While I was drowning in loneliness, hated by everyone, I happened to pick up and raise a pair of siblings who were eating my candy house...

"Hazel the Witch, you're sentenced to execution for kidnapping!"

Who would have known that I'd be falsely accused of kidnapping the Grand Duke's younger siblings!
Thankfully, before she knew it, Hazel became a nanny in the Grand Duchy with the help of the children.

However, her employer once said...
"A Grand Duke doesn't marry witches. Nor nannies, of course."
and gulped down kimchi soup.

I don't have no intention of getting marrying either, you know? Especially not to you, your Grace!
I'll just raise the kids and then quit!

eed06c5c-6f08-46c8-9833-42e40736cecf.title: Gajjareul Wihan Jangsoneun Eopda
eed06c5c-6f08-46c8-9833-42e40736cecf.altTitle: No Place for the Fake Princess
eed06c5c-6f08-46c8-9833-42e40736cecf.description: Setelah bersekongkol dengan ibunya dan memicu perang antara kekaisaran dan menara sihir, Philomel si 'putri palsu' dihukum mati atas semua kejahatannya... Begitulah isi dari buku mencurigakan yang dipungut oleh Philomel di taman. Ia ingin memercayai bahwa cerita di dalam buku itu hanyalah fiksi, tapi semakin hari kejadian di dunia nyata semakin menyerupai buku itu. Agar tidak bernasib sama dengan Philomel yang ada di dalam buku, Philomel memutuskan untuk berusaha bertahan hidup. Akankah hidupnya berjalan sama seperti dengan buku mencurigakan itu?

41a1a0b2-dd04-4507-a931-4dba7687ced2.title: Water Ghost
41a1a0b2-dd04-4507-a931-4dba7687ced2.description:
"I didn’t believe it. Not until I saw it with my own eyes."

Kyungsoo doesn’t believe in ghosts. Dragged along by his friends who want to “see a water ghost,” he’s forced to follow them to a stream in the mountain behind town.

But once they get there... he’s the only one who actually sees it.

e0456082-720e-4f5b-8e37-034afe8393ab.title: Seyakate Tamayo-chan wa Koi ga shitai
e0456082-720e-4f5b-8e37-034afe8393ab.altTitle: Tamayo-chan wants to fall in love!
e0456082-720e-4f5b-8e37-034afe8393ab.description: Guru SMA baru, Haruseto Kazutoyo, punya harga diri yang tinggi sebagai seorang guru. Pelanggaran tata tertib? Nggak bakal dia toleransi! Tapi kemudian, muncul cewek cantik yang ngomong pakai dialek Kansai, Higashiyodogawa Tamayo, yang mengaku sebagai “teman masa kecilnya”! Di depan Tamayo yang terang-terangan manggil dia “Kazu-nii” dan terus nempel manja tanpa jaga jarak, bisakah Kazutoyo tetap bertahan sebagai “guru yang super serius”...!? Romcom beda usia antara guru dan murid yang penuh dengan energi ini resmi dimulai!!
